ActionId.description: Opaque, community-minted identifier of one action. A consumer MUST NOT parse or order it; it is compared for equality only. Long enough to be unguessable, because a show of an id the caller may not see is answered `notFound` and an enumerable id would turn that answer into an oracle.
ActionId.title: ActionId

Ext.description: Vendor-namespaced extension object per SPEC.md §4.5.1. Each immediate key MUST be a reverse-DNS namespace; structure under each namespace is opaque to the framework.
Ext.title: Ext

schema.description: A community tells a subject that a reduction of their administrative authority has been requested and is cooling off: it will land at `landsAt` unless the administrator who requested it cancels it first. Sent when the reduction is parked, never when it lands — vtc/members/authority-reduced-notice reports the landing. The subject cannot block the reduction; the notice exists so that they learn of it before it takes effect. Unsolicited: the subject did not ask.

actionId.description: The cooling-off action holding the reduction. The subject follows it with vtc/admin/actions/show (0.2 or later), where it appears with `callerRole: subject`, to learn whether it was cancelled or landed.

code.description: What will happen when the reduction lands. `revoked`: the subject's access control entry will be removed. `demoted`: its role will be changed to one with a lower ceiling. `narrowed`: its role will stay and what it allows will be reduced. The same set, with the same meanings, as vtc/members/authority-reduced-notice/0.1.

decidedBy.description: DID of the administrator who requested the reduction — the only party who can cancel it before it lands. The community itself is the document's issuer.

did.description: The subject whose authority the pending reduction would reduce — the notice's recipient. Carried in the payload as well as the envelope so that a forwarded notice still names its subject.

landsAt.description: When the reduction takes effect unless its requester cancels it first. Equal to the parked action's `landsAt`; fixed when the reduction was parked.

previousRole.description: The role the subject holds now, before the reduction lands.

reason.description: The requesting administrator's stated reason, verbatim. Absent when none was given; absent and empty are different claims.

requestedAt.description: When the reduction was requested and parked — not when the notice was sent.

resultingRole.description: The role the subject will hold once the reduction lands. Absent exactly when `code` is `revoked`.

schema.title: VTC Members Authority-Reduction-Pending Notice — payload
